pose: Directly facing the camera in a tall, symmetrical 'hero' stance. The head is perfectly centered at the top edge of the 1024px frame, tilted slightly down to emphasize the horns. The muscular neck leads straight down to a deep, narrow chest. The tiny, vestigial arms are tucked tightly to the body to stay within the 140px center-crop zone. This creates a singular, powerful vertical silhouette.

character_details.expression: Signature prominent friendly smirk with a touch of mischievous wit.
character_details.eyes: Large, soulful, and highly expressive eyes that look directly at the viewer.
character_details.skin_texture: Smooth, high-poly 3D surfaces with stylized 'bumpy' osteoderms; avoiding hyper-realistic grain or noise.

environmental_details.ground: Sun-bleached, light-grey silty clay. A warm, golden dust cloud is kicked up around the bird-like feet to provide tactile grounding.
environmental_details.flora: Sparse, low-lying coastal ferns kept to the far left and right edges of the 1024px frame; the center 140px vertical strip remains 100% dinosaur and sky.
environmental_details.sky: Vibrant, deep blue sky providing maximum contrast for the horned silhouette.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Cinematic midday sun with warm golden rim-lighting to highlight the 3D volume and separate the subject from the background.
